newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale faces new obstacle - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale faces new obstacle - paper.

text.p: The president of the Sao Paulo bankers union has denounced a new conflict of interest in connection with the privatization of state mining giant CVRD which could delay the sell-off due to start April 29, Brazil's leading financial daily Gazeta Mercantil reported on Thursday.

Jose Pio Borges, the vice-president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) which oversees the company's privatization, is an active member of the administration council of pulp and paper firm Aracruz Celulose.
